CustomField.label: Missing Requirements
CustomField.formula: IF(TEXT(Status__c) == "Kickoff Completed", "Completed", IF( AND(Contract_Signed__c, Welcome_Email_Sent__c, Initial_Data_Received__c, NOT(ISBLANK(Kickoff_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Implementation_Owner__c))), "All requirements met!", IF(NOT(Contract_Signed__c), "Contract Signed; ", "") & IF(NOT(Welcome_Email_Sent__c), "Welcome Email Sent; ", "") & IF(NOT(Initial_Data_Received__c), "Initial Data Received; ", "") & IF(ISBLANK(Kickoff_Date__c), "Kickoff Date Missing; ", "") & IF(ISBLANK(Implementation_Owner__c), "Implementation Owner Missing; ", "") ) )
